description: This file defines the 'AzureQueueOptions' class, which provides configuration options for an Azure Queue Stream provider, including methods to set up the QueueServiceClient with various authentication mechanisms. It also contains a validator class for these options.

classes.name: AzureQueueOptions
classes.description: Provides configuration settings for Azure Queue Stream provider, including client setup options and properties for queues and timeouts.

classes.name: AzureQueueOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the configured AzureQueueOptions for correctness, specifically ensuring a client is configured and queue names are set.

methods.name: ConfigureQueueServiceClient
methods.description: Multiple overloads for configuring the QueueServiceClient with connection string, URI, credential, or callback.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if the options have valid configuration, such as a properly set client and queue names.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to produce a validator for the AzureQueueOptions in the dependency injection framework.
